name: io.github.Cifero74/mcp-apple-music
description: Apple Music MCP server — broad Apple Music API access for catalog search, library browsing, playlist/folder writes, ratings, favorites, Replay, recommendations, history, and storefront data.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Apple MusicKit private key content (ES256, PEM format)

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_USER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Apple Music user token for personal library, playlist, ratings, favorites, Replay, recommendations, and history tools. Catalog-only tools can run without it.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_STOREFRONT
environmentVariables.description: Apple Music storefront country code (default: us)
